| `/category/{name}` | Lists recipes in a category with ratings | Static SSR |
| `/recipe/{id}` | Full recipe detail with ingredients, steps, and star-rating widget | SSR + Interactive (rating) |
| `/submit` | Form to submit a new recipe (title, category, ingredients, steps) | Interactive Server |

**Key design decisions:**
- **Static SSR by default** — browse/category/recipe pages render server-side with no WebSocket overhead
- **`@rendermode InteractiveServer`** only on the `StarRating` component and `SubmitRecipe` page, since those need click/input handling
- **`RecipeService`** registered as a singleton with 8 seed recipes across 4 cuisines
- Star-rating widget shows hover preview and persists ratings in memory
